annotations.title: Start a $50 (plus tax) video Quick Check

description: Get the link where the person starts TN Appliance Exchange's $50 (plus tax) video Quick Check, plus what it is and how it works: they record a short video of the problem, our technician (Teddy, the owner) reviews it himself and texts back an honest diagnosis with the exact part it needs, and the $50 is credited toward the labor if they go ahead with the repair. Works anywhere in the US. Use it when the person is outside our Tennessee / Louisiana in-home area (check_service_area says not covered), wants an expert look before booking a visit, or is not sure the problem is worth a visit. Do not use it for a gas smell, burning, smoke, sparks or water near wiring: that is safety first (shut off, call (629) 272-1234), and the reply says so when the problem sounds like that. Not for booking an in-home repair (use book_repair). Returns the link (the appliance pre-selected when given), the price, the steps, when to use it and when not, a message you can pass on, and safety_first. Read-only and idempotent: it creates nothing, books nothing, charges nothing, contacts no one and stores nothing. The person opens the link and pays there themselves, so never tell them it is booked, started or paid, and do not promise how fast the answer comes.

appliance.description: Optional. Which appliance, in plain words; it pre-selects that button on the page (fridge, washer, dryer, oven/range, dishwasher, microwave, else Other).

problem.description: Optional. What it is doing, in the person's words. Used only to check for safety-first problems; it is never put in the link and never stored.

zip.description: Optional. 5-digit ZIP of the home; used only to say whether an in-home visit is also an option. Never put in the link and never stored.

name: start_quick_check

error.description: Present only when the call could not be completed; says what to fix or who to call.

in_home_option.description: Only when a ZIP was given: whether an in-home visit is also possible

link.description: The Quick Check page the person opens to start and pay

message.description: A plain-English answer you can pass to the person as is.

safety_first.description: true when the problem sounds like a gas, electrical or water-near-electrical hazard

you_must_not.description: What the assistant must not claim
